notes_for_editor: All four sources are lookout-enthusiast compilations, not Forest Service records; the 1921, 1931 and 1954 dates agree across them but were not checked against primary records. The 'patrol tower 2 miles east on Early Ridge' appears on two pages and the story does not say whether it is a separate structure. Do not confuse with Kellogg Peak (a different lookout). Today's site is not described by any source checked.
